Fibonacci sculpture

A FEW WAYS IN

About this experiment

Drag or use arrows to orbit. Scroll / pinch / + / − zooms. Sequence terms chooses 1–20 cubes; Space adds one term and wraps to the first. Extrusion goes from flat square tiling through full cubes to stretched columns. P freezes automatic rotation; manual controls still work. R changes the view. The numbers on visible cube tops and the readout show the sequence and its ratio to the previous term.

The mathematics

Squares with side lengths 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 and onward tile an expanding rectangle. At full extrusion each becomes a cube with the same Fibonacci edge length. Quarter circles of those radii trace the familiar Fibonacci spiral in the footprint; vertical connectors lift it between cube tops. Lower Extrusion to flatten the sculpture and inspect the tiling. Sequence terms and Space reveal the construction one number at a time. The readout compares consecutive terms with the golden ratio. The camera fits the displayed terms, preserving their exact relative dimensions. The quarter-circle construction is an approximation associated with the logarithmic golden spiral.
